meaning: Mid-November at Engulf's site in past years: the baseline the readings compare forecasts with.

site_daily.source: PRISM 4 km daily via ACIS GridData grid 21 (modelled from stations)

burn_hours.source: McComb/Lewis Field, MS (ASOS), hourly ASOS via Iowa Environmental Mesonet (measured, 26 km from the site)
burn_hours.caveat: Gusts are reported only when they occur, so a night with no gust report counts as under 25 mph. The station's wind sensor is in open airport ground; a camp among trees usually feels less wind. Reports are hourly (routine METARs), so a short squall between reports can be missed.
